description: Visual identity of a person or entity, by image or initials.

howToUse: Use it to show who: the author of a comment, the owner of a task, the account signed in.
Pass `src` with the photo and `initials` as fallback; `alt` with the name when the name is not next to it.
Use `shape="square"` for companies and projects, and `seed` for a fixed color per name.
alternatives: Avatar with name and detail in a row: PersonCell.

keyboard.action: The avatar does not receive focus. Wrap it in a link or button when it opens a profile.

props.name: initials
props.description: Initials (1–2 letters) when there is no image.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL; when present, it covers the initials.

props.name: shape
props.description:
Shape: `circle` (person, default) or `square` (workspace/project/logo,
rounded corners proportional to size).

props.name: color
props.description: Background color (for initials). Default = the active brand color.

props.name: seed
props.description:
Seed for a deterministic brand gradient (e.g. the workspace name).
The same string always produces the same gradient. Ignored with `src`/`color`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

examples.label: Initials

Square (entity)
